name: Jochebed
title: Moses' Faithful Mother
summary: Jochebed was a Levite woman who showed extraordinary courage and faith by hiding her son Moses for three months to protect him from Pharaoh's death decree against Hebrew baby boys. She placed him in a basket on the Nile, which led to his being found and adopted by Pharaoh's daughter. Her faith is counted among the great examples of faith in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Hiding Moses for Three Months
keyEvents.description: When Jochebed saw that Moses was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months to save him from Pharaoh's command to kill all Hebrew baby boys.

keyEvents.title: Placing Moses in a Basket on the Nile
keyEvents.description: When she could no longer hide him, she made a basket of papyrus, sealed it with tar and pitch, placed the child inside, and set the basket among the reeds by the bank of the Nile.

keyEvents.title: Becomes Moses' Nurse
keyEvents.description: Through Miriam's wise suggestion, Jochebed was hired by Pharaoh's daughter as a nurse for her own child and even received payment to raise him.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Lineage of Levi
keyEvents.description: Jochebed is mentioned as Amram's wife and as the mother of Aaron and Moses. She was the daughter of Levi, born in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Her Faith Honored in Hebrews
keyEvents.description: The faith of Moses' parents is highlighted in Hebrews, where it says that by faith they hid Moses for three months because they saw he was a beautiful child and were not afraid of the king's command.
